advisor.reasoning: Current conditions argue strongly AGAINST this NO position winning. At 12:00Z (4am local) LAX reads 75.2F (run_max) with OVC/BKN cloud deck at 6000-9000ft, light rain reported, SW onshore flow at 9kt — classic marine-layer suppression onset. Cloud bases are lowering print-to-print (deck fate = lid, not dissolving). SST=74.1F caps sea-breeze equilibrium near 75F. The 76-77F bucket NO is at 97c, market consensus pins max 76-77F range, not clearing 75. Guidance spread is wide (NWS 80, metno 75.8, ecmwf 76.8) but live obs with rain and OVC strongly favor the cooler models. Day needs to exceed 75F ceiling; marine stratus + rain + onshore flow makes that unlikely.
advisor.watch: Cloud base rising above BKN090 with winds shifting calm/offshore and temp climbing past 76F by 14:00Z would flip to heat-clearing scenario
